about: 24/7 agent tasks for JeeA!. Each task runs on GitHub Actions when it is due. 'every' accepts 30m, 1h, 6h, 1d, 7d. 'model' is 'auto' (first provider with a secret, else the free model) or 'provider:model', e.g. 'groq:llama-3.3-70b-versatile'. Tools: search_wikipedia, read_wikipedia, fetch_url, calculate, get_datetime, previous_result.

tasks.name: Daily tech digest
tasks.prompt: Read the Hacker News front page feed at https://news.ycombinator.com/rss. Write a digest of the 5 most interesting stories: one plain-English line each, with the link. Then use previous_result and mark stories that were not in the last digest as NEW.

tasks.name: Fact of the day
tasks.prompt: Use get_datetime to find today's date. Find one notable event in science or history that happened on this calendar day, research it with search_wikipedia and read_wikipedia, and write a 150-word explanation in simple English with the Wikipedia link.
